item.title: Xamarin
item.description:
Many companies are currently involved in the development of mobile applications. To reach as many users as possible, there must be support for several platforms. Android and iOS are the largest of these. To create an application for every platform develop and maintain, costs can run high. That is why many companies do research into how these costs can be reduced.

The purpose of this study is to find out if Xamarin is a suitable solution for QNH Consulting to develop cross-platform applications. Here is the following main question: “To what extent is Xamarin suitable for QNH Consulting to develop platform applications that run on Android, iOS and Windows?”
